# Get Workspace Photos

Retrieves all photos associated with a workspace.

This endpoint is publicly accessible.

## Authorization

No Authentication Required

## Endpoint

GET /api/workspaces/:id/photos

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| workspace_id | The workspace ID. |

## Request Body

None

## Success Response (200)

``` json
[
  {
    "id": "photo-id",
    "workspace_id": "workspace-id",
    "image_url": "https://...",
    "created_at": "2026-08-03T12:00:00.000Z"
  }
]

 ```

## Error Responses

### 404 Not Found

Returned if the workspace does not exist.

hDelete Workspace Photo

Deletes a photo belonging to a workspace.

Only the workspace owner (Host) or an Admin can delete a photo.

## Authorization

Bearer Token (Host or Admin)

## Endpoint

DELETE /api/workspaces/:workspaceId/photos/:photoId

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| workspace_id | Workspace ID |
| photo_id | Photo ID |

## Request Body

None

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Photo deleted successfully",
  "photos_remaining": 0,
  "media_status": "incomplete"
}

 ```

## Error Responses

### 403 Forbidden

Returned when a user who is not the workspace owner or an admin attempts to delete the photo.

### 404 Not Found

Returned if the workspace or photo does not exist.

# POST /api/bookings

Creates a booking.

**Authorization:** `Bearer {{seekerToken}}`

## Example Success Response (201)

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Booking created successfully. Pending payment confirmation.",
  "data": {
    "booking": {
      "id": "...",
      "workspace_id": "...",
      "seeker_id": "...",
      "start_time": "2026-08-03T14:00:00.000Z",
      "end_time": "2026-08-03T16:00:00.000Z",
      "status": "pending_payment",
      "total_amount": "5000.00"
    }
  }
}

 ```

## Error Responses

### 409 Conflict

``` json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Selected time slot is no longer available."
}

 ```

### 403 Forbidden

- Corporate budget exceeded
    
- User not authorized
    

### 400 Bad Request

- Workspace not found
    
- Workspace not currently bookable

## Concurrency Test

This endpoint uses database transactions with row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) to prevent double booking.

To verify:

1. Obtain a valid seeker token.
    
2. Send two `POST /api/bookings` requests simultaneously using the same `workspaceId`, `startTime`, and `endTime`.
    
3. Expected result:
    
    - One request returns **201 Created**.
        
    - The other returns **409 Conflict** with the message:  
        `"Selected time slot is no longer available."`
        

A reusable `concurrency-test.js` script is available in the project root for this test.

### Success Response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Booking created successfully. Pending payment confirmation."
}

 ```

  

## Notes

This endpoint is concurrency-safe.

If two users attempt to book the same workspace for the same time simultaneously, only one booking will succeed.

The second request returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

Declines a pending booking request.

Cancels an existing booking. Either the seeker or the host can cancel. The response includes the `cancelled_by` field, which downstream services use for refund processing.

**Authentication:** Use either a seeker or host access token.

- If a seeker cancels, `cancelled_by` will be `"seeker"`.
    
- If a host cancels, `cancelled_by` will be `"host"`.
    

### Success Response

``` json
"cancelled_by": "seeker"

 ```

or

``` json
"cancelled_by": "host"



 ```

## Notes

The cancelled_by field indicates who initiated the cancellation.

Possible values:

- seeker
    
- host
    

This field is used by the refund policy.

# Complete Booking

Marks an in-progress booking as completed.

Only the workspace host (or an admin) can complete a booking.

Once completed, the seeker becomes eligible to submit a review.

## Authorization

Bearer Token (Host)

## Endpoint

PATCH /api/bookings/:id/complete

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| booking_id | The ID of the booking to complete. |

## Request Body

None

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Session marked as completed. The seeker can now leave a review.",
  "data": {
    "booking": {
      "status": "completed"
    }
  }
}

 ```

## Error Responses

### 403 Forbidden

Returned when a seeker attempts to complete a booking.

### 404 Not Found

Returned if the booking does not exist.

### 400 Bad Request

Returned if the booking cannot be completed because it is not currently in progress.

g Review Booking

Allows the seeker to submit a review after a booking has been completed.

A booking can only be reviewed once.

## Authorization

Bearer Token (Seeker)

## Endpoint

POST /api/bookings/:id/review

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| booking_id | The completed booking ID. |

## Request Body

``` json
{
  "overallRating": 2,
  "powerReliabilityRating": 1,
  "internetReliabilityRating": 2,
  "powerStable": false,
  "internetAsDescribed": false,
  "comment": "Power went out twice during my session"
}

 ```

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Review submitted successfully",
  "data": {
    "review": {},
    "reliability": {
      "workspaceId": "...",
      "reliabilityScore": 0,
      "reviewCount": 1,
      "flagged": false
    }
  }
}

 ```

## Error Responses

### 409 Conflict

Returned if the seeker has already submitted a review for this booking.

### 403 Forbidden

Returned if the authenticated user is not the booking owner.

### 404 Not Found

Returned if the booking does not exist.
